Hi Elena — thanks for the quick repro info and the attachments. I can see the W9 — appreciate that.

Preliminary read (internal note for Marissa/Rafael): the screenshot + the SAML snippet show two OrganizationName attributes in the assertion (Okta sometimes includes both an "organization" and an "orgDisplayName" attribute). Our Coupa onboarding handler expects a single tenant identifier and treats extra org attributes as an ambiguity — the invite validation appears to reject the assertion rather than mapping it.

Elena — I'm escalating to our onboarding engineering team. In the meantime, can you confirm: 1) the exact redirect URL you clicked (copy/paste), and 2) whether you can open the invite link in an incognito window or from a different network (sometimes corporate proxies rewrite headers). If you prefer, we can manually create the vendor record and send a DocuSign link for the W9 + bank setup.

I'll loop Rafael for a quicker fix; Marissa, can procurement approve a temporary manual activation so their first PO can be processed?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0102

Forwarding vendor report — Horizon Lighting cannot accept the Coupa invite. They attached a populated W9.

Problem summary (TL;DR): Coupa invite endpoint is rejecting SAML assertions that contain multiple org attributes. That looks like a tenant-binding ambiguity introduced by our IdP-mapping logic. If we can't fix mapping today, procurement has asked for a manual activation for the vendor so they can receive POs.

Requesting actions:
- Rafael: can engineering create the vendor record directly in the Coupa admin console (admin->Suppliers->Create) and mark the contact as verified so the vendor can receive the PO? If so, please set a temporary acceptance token and paste a one-time link here.
- Marissa: procurement approval to manually onboard for this account and accept the W9 on file. I have attached their W9 to this forward.

I've opened a Jira ticket to track the dev work: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/JIRA-7891 (assign to Rafael). I've also started a Coupa support case: CS-45211. If engineering prefers, a short-hotfix to ignore duplicate org attributes (pick first match) would resolve acceptance.

Ben

Thanks for the ping — I dug into the onboarding logs and Coupa's assertion parser: we do treat duplicate org/name attributes as a mismatch unless a mapping rule exists. Short-term plan:

1) Manual onboard (completed): I created supplier record Horizon Lighting (internal id: HZN-2046) in our Coupa admin console and uploaded the W9 you provided.
2) One-time activation: generated a temporary acceptance URL (valid 72 hours) and sent it directly to Elena's address. Elena, you should receive an email from no-reply@redwood.com with subject "Redwood supplier activation: Horizon Lighting" — please click that once (try incognito if you hit the same proxy).
3) Longer-term fix: I've filed JIRA-7891 and will implement a tolerant mapping (choose first non-empty org attribute) and add a unit test. ETA for PR: ~3 business days. I've attached the Coupa support case (CS-45211) to the ticket.

Coupa case note: support confirmed this is a common IdP configuration issue and recommended the tolerant-mapping patch. They also sent a helper link for IdP attribute trimming: https://na1.coupasupport.com/solutions/article/saml-attribute-mapping-guidance

Elena — if you don't see the activation email in the next 10 minutes please check spam; if you still can't accept we'll manually toggle the contact to "Active" so procurement can push the PO.

Rafael Mendes
